_comment: CAPA (corrective/preventive action) + verification tables. Phase 6. owner_id and verifier_id must always differ — enforced in functions/shared/pure/capa-workflow.ts (isValidOwnerVerifierPair) before any write, not just assumed from the schema. CAPAVerification is its own table, not columns on CAPA, mirroring the IncidentInvestigation split from Phase 5 — this is what lets the Group/Hotel/Department Manager dashboards query 'CAPA awaiting verification' independently of 'CAPA awaiting owner update' (docs/2026-07-zoho-catalyst-access-and-dashboard-model.md §6). CAPA.capa_priority (named capa_priority, not priority, because Catalyst rejects 'priority' as a reserved column-name keyword), root_cause, corrective_action, preventive_action, hierarchy_of_control, cost, required_evidence, effectiveness_review_date, final_approved_by and final_approved_at were added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration (Phase C, apps/web capa module) — they existed on Postgres's capa_actions table and are used by the CAPA create/detail UI, but were missing from the original Phase 6 port.

columns.comment: The row-scoping column — every query MUST run through propertyScopeClause().
Nullable — not every CAPA is department-scoped. Required for the Department Manager Dashboard's 'assigned CAPA' row.

incident | audit_finding | legal_gap | inspection | management_review — what this CAPA closes out. Used for drill-down and framework linkage. (Widened from the original incident | audit_finding | control_gap comment during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration to match the full capa_source_type enum apps/web's CAPA form actually writes — see apps/web/src/db/schema/_enums.ts.)
ROWID of the originating Incidents / AuditFindings / CriticalGaps row.
Must differ from verifier_id — see isValidOwnerVerifierPair().
Must differ from owner_id — see isValidOwnerVerifierPair().
open | in_progress | pending_verification | verified | closed — validated against isValidCapaStatusTransition() in capa-workflow.ts.

low | medium | high | critical. Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 6 port; present on capa_actions.priority in the Postgres schema and used by the CAPA list/detail/create UI. Named capa_priority, not priority — Catalyst rejects 'priority' as a reserved column-name keyword.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 6 port; ported from capa_actions.root_cause.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 6 port; ported from capa_actions.corrective_action.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 6 port; ported from capa_actions.preventive_action.

elimination | substitution | engineering | administrative | ppe. Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 6 port; ported from capa_actions.hierarchy_of_control.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 6 port; ported from capa_actions.cost (numeric(12,2) in Postgres).
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 6 port; ported from capa_actions.required_evidence.
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 6 port; ported from capa_actions.effectiveness_review_date.

Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 6 port; ported from capa_actions.final_approved_by. Set on closeCapaAction; must differ from owner_id (the owner cannot give their own final closure approval).
Added during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration — missing from the original Phase 6 port; ported from capa_actions.final_approved_at.

tables.comment: Owner-entered progress updates and evidence references, one row per update — keeps the audit trail of what the owner actually did without overwriting a single free-text column each time.

columns.comment: Catalyst File Store reference; the evidence library itself ships in Phase 7.

tables.comment: The verification DECISION as its own record, separate from CAPA.status — captures who verified, when, and the outcome, so 'CAPA awaiting verification' and 'CAPA rejected back to owner' are both queryable without conflating them with 'CAPA awaiting owner update'. Every insert here is preceded by a re-check that verifier_id != CAPA.owner_id (defence in depth beyond the check at CAPA creation).

columns.comment: effective | not_effective — matches Postgres's capa_verification_outcome enum and apps/web's CAPA verify form; corrected during the Supabase-to-Catalyst migration from this column's original 'verified | rejected' comment, which didn't match what the app actually writes.
